meta.title: TableTap — QR ordering with a live kitchen display
meta.description: The guest scans a code at the table, picks dishes and places the order. The kitchen sees it the same moment. The demo is open, no sign-up required.

hero.line2: The kitchen sees it in real time.
hero.subtitle: The guest taps — the ticket prints in the kitchen. Try it yourself below.

guest.text: Scan the code with your phone, or open table 7 right here.

kitchen.text: Tickets appear the moment a guest orders. Opens the live board signed in as kitchen staff.

admin.text: Edit the menu, the tables and the codes, and read the day. Opens the dashboard signed in as an admin.

notices.demoPayments: Payments run in demo mode: no card, no money.
notices.coldStart: On the free tier the API sleeps when nobody is here, so the first page after a quiet spell can take about a minute.

rush.caption: Twelve orders over one minute, so the board has something to do.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
steps: Scan the QR code on the table.
Pick dishes and add a note.
Follow its status on your phone.

landing.footer: Source, ADRs and the case study live in the repository README.
